verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer intent-classification-2 reference, this board offers stronger tinted stage grouping and semantic flow colors but lacks the reference’s clean routing, generous air, and immediately legible hierarchy.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The three main horizontal stages and lower-right operations panel use the frame well, though the upper stage is noticeably more crowded than the lower regions.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: FAIL: Many chips have adequate padding, but central labels such as “authenticated + tagged,” “normalized + redacted,” and “completed partitions” are squeezed against nodes or partially obscured by them.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Large blue, teal, lavender, and orange tinted regions clearly separate ingest, transform, storage/query, and operations, with labeled headers making the grouping functional.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Blue, teal, purple, orange, and red consistently distinguish flow families and exception paths, although the number of simultaneous hues and dashed orange/red routes creates some visual noise.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: FAIL: There are no crosshair junctions, but several arrowheads terminate amid dense bends or shared runs, and the standalone lightning alert icon reads slightly like a floating badge.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The broad stage registers hold, but node baselines vary within sections, several labels are visibly truncated inside boxes, and the dense middle-right repair cluster disrupts the otherwise orderly rhythm.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: FAIL: Long dashed feedback paths, nested bends around the durable log and repair area, close parallel runs, and label/edge interference make several routes difficult to trace cleanly.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The visual ordering and assigned scores agree: gc-decomp-harness ranks first at 7.5, intent-classification-2 second at 7.0, and the board under grade third at 6.5.
